scholarship_title: University of Cagliari PhD Scholarships, 42nd Cycle (2026/2027)
provider_organization: University of Cagliari (UniCa), with Sardinia Region ESF+ STEP funds and partner bodies

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: No enrolment or attendance fees; only EUR 16 stamp duty and the EUR 140 regional tax (if due) each year

stipend.notes: EUR 16,243 gross a year for 3 years, paid monthly; raised by up to 50% during authorised periods abroad. Lost if your other gross income exceeds EUR 16,243 a year.

additional_benefits: Mandatory 6 to 12 month research period abroad with increased scholarship

application_fee.notes: Non-refundable selection fee via PagoPA, per PhD programme applied to

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Master's-level (second-cycle) degree, or a foreign degree judged equivalent by the committee; can graduate by 31 Oct 2026

required_documents.name: Master's degree certificate with exam list
required_documents.detail: Grades, credits, average, grading scale, final grade and dates; translated into Italian or English

required_documents.name: Bachelor's degree certificate with exam list
Passport scan
required_documents.detail: Colour scan; must be valid at least six months after the deadline

required_documents.name: Up to three reference letters
required_documents.detail: Reserved places for foreign-degree holders: on UniCa's template, in English, on letterhead, sent by referees to phdcall_referenceletter@unica.it by the deadline

required_documents.name: Other qualifications, publications, language certificates
required_documents.detail: Optional unless the programme annex says mandatory

required_documents.name: Declaration of Value or CIMEA statement and legalised Italian translation of the degree

preparation_alerts: Ask referees early: they must email letters directly by the application deadline
Request a Declaration of Value from the Italian embassy or a CIMEA statement for enrolment
Apply separately (and pay the fee) for each PhD programme

criteria.notes: Reserved places for foreign-degree holders; at least 30 points on qualifications needed for interview

selection_criteria.pass_rule: At least 60 of 100 points. Ordinary places use a different scale: academic career 45, experience 15, test/interview 40.

source_urls.title: UniCa: PhD call Cycle 42, English translation (PDF, Rector's Decree 856/2026)
source_urls.used_for: All fields: positions, reserved places, amounts, fee, documents, selection, dates

verification_status.verification_notes: Read the English translation of the Cycle 42 call (Italian version is official). 149 positions: 109 ordinary with scholarship, 17 without, 19 with scholarship reserved for foreign candidates with a foreign degree (about one per programme), 2 for foreign-government scholarship holders, 2 for international mobility scholars. 128 scholarships in total. PhDs start 16 Nov 2026. Programme-specific requirements are in annexes not read.
